description: Output schema for remy-secure false-positive filter agents. Each agent evaluates one finding.

original_finding_file.description: File path from the original finding being evaluated.

original_finding_line.description: Line number from the original finding being evaluated.

confidence.description: Confidence that this is a true positive. 1-3 = false positive, 4-6 = uncertain, 7-10 = true positive.

reasoning.description: 2-3 sentences explaining the confidence score assignment.

exclusion_match.description: ID of matched exclusion rule (e.g., 'EX-003'), or null if none match.

precedent_match.description: ID of matched precedent (e.g., 'PR-006'), or null if none match.
